THEME-TOGGLE MOTION — four options on the real diegodamian.com tokens (#0a0e1a / #f3f0ea, Poppins, record-red + cobalt accents). Click each sun/moon toggle; the Motion slider on each artboard retimes it.

Crossfade is what shipped today (the D8 system). Circular reveal is the recommended step up — the View Transitions API, same cost as the crossfade, reads as deliberate; it falls back to the crossfade on Firefox and honours reduced-motion. Wipe and Dip are here for contrast, not as recommendations.

Schematic hero, not the full turntable — sun/moon are placeholder SVGs (the site masks PNGs).
